(خذ) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta"; (من أموال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خذ), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (صدقة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (تطهّر) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "hiya" [Note: Or "anta", i.e. "you purify them" (and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of خذ).]; (الواو) conjunction; (تزكّيهم) like تطهّرهم, and the fāʿil is "anta"; (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تزكّي); (الواو) conjunction; (صلّ) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (صلّ); (أنّ) like the previous one; (صلاة) the subject (ism) of inna, accusative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (سكن) khabar (predicate), nominative; (لهم) like بها, attached to (سكن); (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (سميع) khabar, nominative; (عليم) second khabar, nominative.
The clause «خذ ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تطهّرهم» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of صدقة [Note: The linking pronoun is implied if the fāʿil is "anta", i.e. "you purify them by it".. and it may be a ḥāl from the pronoun of خذ.].
The clause «تزكّيهم بها» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تطهّرهم [Note: Whether the clause تطهّرهم is a naʿt or a ḥāl.].
The clause «صلّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خذ.
The clause «إنّ صلاتك سكن ...» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «الله سميع ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(صلّ): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion to suit the indeclinable building; its imperfect is يصلّي, and its wazn is فعّ.
(سكن): see verse (96) of Sūrat al-Anʿām. سكن is فعل with two fatḥas, in the sense of a passive participle, i.e. "that in which one finds repose"; here it is a metonymy for reassurance and mercy.

safi-cedvel:104-104.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); (لم) a particle of negation and jussive; (يعلموا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its sign of jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the waw is the fāʿil (agent); (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh); (الله) the Divine Name, the subject (ism) of anna, accusative (manṣūb); (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: The pronoun here is not parsed as a pronoun of separation (faṣl), because what follows it cannot be an adjective, or does not give the impression of being an adjective..
As for the second pronoun, it may be parsed as a pronoun of separation, because (التوّاب) could be an adjective.]; (يقبل) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (التوبة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (عن عباد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يقبل), by making it imply the meaning of "to pass over" [Note: The following appears in the Ḥāshiya of al-Jamal: "عن عباده is attached to (يقبل); it is made transitive with عن only because the meaning of من and the meaning of عن are close. Ibn ʿAṭiyya said: Often in a single place one connects with this one and with that one, as in لا صدقة إلّا عن غنى and من غنى." End quote.], and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (يأخذ) like يقبل; (الصدقات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its sign of accusative being the kasra; (الواو) conjunction; (أنّ الله هو) like the first; (التوّاب) khabar (predicate) of anna, nominative; (الرحيم) second khabar, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أنّ الله.. يقبل) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يعلموا.
The second interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله.. التواب) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the first interpreted maṣdar and confirming its meaning.
The clause «لم يعلموا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هو يقبل ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of anna.
The clause «يقبل ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of هو.
The clause «يأخذ ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يقبل.

* Rhetoric:
Istiʿāra (metaphor): in His saying, Exalted is He, «وَيَأْخُذُ الصَّدَقاتِ», i.e. He accepts them as one accepts who takes something in order to pay its equivalent; "taking" here is a metaphor for acceptance. It has also been allowed that attributing "taking" to Allah the Exalted is a majāz mursal (non-metaphorical trope).

safi-cedvel:105-105.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قل) like خذ [Note: in verse (103) of this sūra.]; (اعملوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the waw is the fāʿil (agent); (الفاء) causal; (سيرى الله ... كنتم تعملون) the i'rab of its counterpart has been given, word by word and clause by clause [Note: in verse (94) of this sūra.], and (المؤمنون) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) by the waw to the Divine Name, nominative (marfūʿ), its sign of nominative being the waw.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «اعملوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «سيرى الله ...» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Rhetoric:
Majāz (figurative usage): in His saying, Exalted is He, «فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِما كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ». "Informing" is a figure for recompense, or a metonymy, i.e. He will recompense you according to that: if good, then good, and if evil, then evil. So the verse contains a promise and a threat.

safi-cedvel:106-106.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (آخرون) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), its sign of nominative being the waw; (مرجون) naʿt (adjective), nominative, its sign of nominative being the waw; (لأمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مرجون); (الله) the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (إمّا) a particle of vagueness — or of doubt; (يعذّب) imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الواو) conjunction; (إمّا يتوب) like the first and conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it, and the fāʿil (agent) of the two verbs is the pronoun "huwa"; (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يتوب); (واللَّه عليم حكيم) like واللَّه سميع عليم [Note: in verse (103) of this sūra.].
The clause «آخرون.. إمّا يعذّبهم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قل.. [Note: in the previous verse; or it is resumptive in origin.. and the clause يعذّبهم may be a second khabar (predicate) if (مرجون) is a first khabar.].
The clause «يعذّبهم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (آخرون).
The clause «يتوب عليهم» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يعذّبهم.
The clause «اللَّه عليم ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مرجون): plural of مرجا, which is lightened from مرجأ, a passive participle of the four-letter verb أرجى; its wazn is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.. مرجون contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion to suit the plural; its origin is مرجيون, where the ḍamma of the yāʾ was transferred to the jīm, so two sukūns met, and the yāʾ was dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns.
